## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible problem and the chosen scope.

## What changed?

Summarize the implementation and any public contract, project artifact, or
workflow change.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes locally, or I explained why it could not run.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private media, personal project data, or assets with unclear redistribution rights.

## Evidence

Include concise test output, a safe fixture, or a redacted QC artifact when it
helps reviewers verify the change.
